canonical_name: Hormander's theorem for sums of squares (subelliptic/hypoelliptic regularity)
canonical_statement: Provisional source-faithful scope: a second-order operator built from smooth real vector fields is hypoelliptic where the Lie algebra generated by the fields has full rank. The exact operator convention, role of the drift field, local domain, and whether the root is the subelliptic estimate or its hypoellipticity consequence remain deliberately unfrozen pending the statement phase.
domain_and_universes: Expected local Euclidean domain with finite families of smooth real vector fields and scalar distributions; exact Lean universes and object model are not yet fixed.
quantifiers: finite smooth real vector fields X_0, ..., X_r on Omega
point x in Omega (or locally uniformly on Omega)
hypotheses: the Lie algebra generated by the relevant vector fields spans the tangent space at each point
coefficients have the smoothness required by the selected primary-source version
P u has the local regularity required by the selected hypoellipticity/subellipticity formulation
conclusion: Either the source theorem's local hypoellipticity conclusion (Pu smooth implies u smooth) or its quantitatively specified subelliptic Sobolev estimate; selection is an open statement-phase obligation, not silently interchangeable.

alternate_encodings.target: local subelliptic Sobolev estimate with positive derivative gain
alternate_encodings.relationship: analytic estimate used to obtain regularity; exact equivalence requires hypotheses and localization

excluded_degenerate_cases: No elliptic-only specialization, finite-dimensional surrogate, ODE case, or arbitrary theorem merely bearing Hormander's name may replace the root. Failure of the bracket condition and boundary-value variants are outside the provisional root.
